constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (admission_id, recipient_email) REFERENCES admissions(id, authorized_email) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((attempt_count = 0) AND (last_attempt_at IS NULL)) OR ((attempt_count > 0) AND (last_attempt_at IS NOT NULL) AND (last_attempt_at >= issued_at))))

CHECK (((expires_at > issued_at) AND (expires_at <= (issued_at +
CASE
    WHEN (purpose = 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION'::"AdmissionChallengePurpose") THEN '00:15:00'::interval
    ELSE '00:30:00'::interval
END))))

CHECK ((((status = 'PENDING'::"AdmissionChallengeStatus") AND (consumed_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CONSUMED'::"AdmissionChallengeStatus") AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_at >= issued_at) AND (consumed_at < expires_at) AND (attempt_count > 0) AND (last_attempt_at = consumed_at) AND (revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'REVOKED'::"AdmissionChallengeStatus") AND (consumed_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_at >= issued_at))))
FOREIGN KEY (authorized_by_admin_id, authorized_by_identity_id) REFERENCES platform_admins(id, identity_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((status = 'CANCELLED'::"AdmissionStatus") AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_at >= authorized_at) AND (cancelled_by_admin_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_by_identity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(btrim(cancellation_reason)) >= 3) AND (length(btrim(cancellation_reason)) <= 200))) OR ((status <> 'CANCELLED'::"AdmissionStatus") AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_by_admin_id IS NULL) AND (cancelled_by_identity_id IS NULL) AND (cancellation_reason IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (cancelled_by_admin_id, cancelled_by_identity_id) REFERENCES platform_admins(id, identity_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (experiment_invitation_id) REFERENCES experiment_invitations(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (identity_id) REFERENCES auth_identities(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (membership_id, identity_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(id, identity_id, tenant_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((status = 'PROVISIONED'::"AdmissionStatus") AND (tenant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (identity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (membership_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provisioned_at IS NOT NULL) AND (email_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provisioned_at >= email_verified_at) AND (provisioned_at < expires_at)) OR ((status <> 'PROVISIONED'::"AdmissionStatus") AND (tenant_id IS NULL) AND (identity_id IS NULL) AND (membership_id IS NULL) AND (provisioned_at IS NULL))))

CHECK (((source = 'AUTHORIZED_INVITE'::"AdmissionSource") AND (experiment_invitation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_reference = experiment_invitation_id) AND (authorized_by_admin_id IS NOT NULL) AND (authorized_by_identity_id IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((verified_challenge_id IS NULL) AND (email_verified_at IS NULL)) OR ((verified_challenge_id IS NOT NULL) AND (email_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (email_verified_at >= authorized_at) AND (email_verified_at < expires_at))))
FOREIGN KEY (verified_challenge_id, id) REFERENCES admission_challenges(id, admission_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
